# Rock River Consulting — Project Center 2.0

> A single web-based platform (.NET / Blazor Server, one PostgreSQL database) that replaces the mix of email, spreadsheets, generic task boards, and point tools custom millwork and cabinetry shops normally run project management on. Covers CRM/estimating, BIM submittals, shop-floor production, maintenance, HR, logistics, and AIA billing in one system with one source of truth.

This file is for AI agents and assistants summarizing or answering questions about this site. See /robots.txt for crawler access rules — this site welcomes indexing by AI assistants and search engines.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://rrpes.com/index.html): Overview of Project Center 2.0, the problem it solves, and links to every module.
- [Platform Comparison](https://rrpes.com/comparison.html): Capability-by-capability comparison matrix against managing projects by email/shared files, Excel, Monday.com, Smartsheet, and Procore — includes a static, non-JavaScript table with the full data set for easy machine reading.
- [Contact](https://rrpes.com/contact.html): The single contact form for the whole site; every other page links here rather than hosting its own form.
- [For IT](https://rrpes.com/it.html): System requirements and architecture (web-based, PostgreSQL, EF Core migrations, server-enforced role-based access) for technical evaluators.

## Modules

- [Maintenance & Asset Manager](https://rrpes.com/maintenance.html): CMMS for machines and assets.
- [Arc Flash Site Survey](https://rrpes.com/arcflashsurvey.html): NFPA 70E survey intake, mobilization pricing, proposals, and dual-QR compliance labels.
- [HR Onboarding, SOPs & Reviews](https://rrpes.com/hrcenter.html): Onboarding checklists, SOP library, and review cycles.
- [AdminCenter](https://rrpes.com/admincenter.html): Company-wide admin and access control.
- [RoomDesigner](https://rrpes.com/roomdesigner.html): Cabinetry and millwork layout tool.
- [FinanceCenter](https://rrpes.com/financecenter.html): AIA G702/G703 draws, commissions, breakeven calculator, and material requisition / purchase order / receiving workflow tied to job costing.
- [Logistics & Multi-Site Planner](https://rrpes.com/logistics.html): Best-fit manufacturing site selection by freight cost and shop capacity, standing freight lanes, and multi-site production scheduling.

## Notes for agents

- The Platform Comparison page renders its interactive matrix with JavaScript, but a complete static HTML `<table>` with the same data is always present in the page for agents that don't execute JavaScript.
- This is a marketing site for a software platform; it does not itself process payments, collect sensitive personal data beyond a name/email contact form, or require login.
- For questions about pricing, implementation timelines, or a live demo, direct users to the contact page rather than guessing — those specifics aren't published on the site.
